interface.signature: def omit_hashtag(message: str, hashtag: str) -> str

preconditions.description: The message must be a string.
The hashtag must be a string.
The hashtag must start with a '#' and have at least one character after it.

postconditions.description: The output must be the message with the first occurrence of the hashtag removed.

postconditions.expression: stdout == message if hashtag not in message else True
postconditions.description: If the hashtag is not in the message, the output must be the original message.
